text:
marta (PM): we need a quick re-eval of the MVP slice after customer feedback. ask: can we pause the 'configurable kv-cache TTL' feature and save it for v1? it touches the serving runtime and has some perf unknowns.
ben (Eng): that KV TTL change requires iteration across runtime + client SDKs. risky in the release window. +1 to pause.
liam (SRE): pausing avoids a risky kernel change during the freeze. we should keep observability hooks to know cache hit-rate per-model.
eve (CS): customers who asked for TTL primarily want to avoid stale responses for streaming. if we postpone, what's our mitigation?
rajesh (Design): UX mitigation: show a 'real-time mode' label and explain current cache behaviour. small modal + docs update.
marta (PM): decision: pause configurable KV TTL, create mitigation docs, add observability metrics. owners: ben (runtime feature flagging), liam (metrics), rajesh (modal copy), eve (customer comms).
ben (Eng): feature-flagging path planned. estimate 1 eng-day to gate and remove migrations.
liam (SRE): will add cache_hit_rate, cache_miss_reason tags to dashboard. scheduling for 1739121200.
eve (CS): communication: "Were deferring configurable TTL to v1 to focus on latency and stability. For customers needing realtime guarantees, contact us for early access." will share copy for modal.
marta (PM): I'll update roadmap and milestone board. if anything else risky shows up, escalate. :thumbsup:
